cases.query: What does the Controlled Substance Dispensing Policy document say?
cases.expected_answer: Controlled Substance Dispensing Policy Purpose This policy establishes procedures for the receipt, storage, dispensing, record-keeping, and disposal of controlled substances at HKI Pharmacy in compliance with DEA, state pharmacy board, and federal regulations.

cases.query: What does the High-Risk Drug Interaction Guidelines document say?
cases.expected_answer: High-Risk Drug Interaction Guidelines Purpose This reference document catalogs the most clinically significant drug-drug interactions encountered at HKI Pharmacy. cases.expected_answer: HKI Pharmacy Immunization Program Overview HKI Pharmacy provides immunization services across all locations with a licensed pharmacist on duty. This document covers protocols, eligible vaccines, patient screening, documentation, and emergency procedures.

cases.query: What does the Prescription Fulfillment Standard Operating Procedure document say?
cases.expected_answer: Prescription Fulfillment Standard Operating Procedure Purpose This document outlines the standard operating procedure for fulfilling prescriptions at HKI Pharmacy locations. cases.query: What does the Advanced Kubernetes Networking with Cilium eBPF document say?
cases.expected_answer: Advanced Kubernetes Networking with Cilium eBPF Overview This document covers the implementation of Cilium as a CNI (Container Network Interface) plugin for Kubernetes clusters, replacing kube-proxy with eBPF-based networking for improved performance and observability. Architecture Cilium operates at Linux kernel level using eBPF (extended Berkeley Packet Filter) programs that are attached to network hooks.
